claims.text: VERDICT: REJECT, and it is a decision-quality result with an exact number. dflash8 (z-lab/Qwen3.5-27B-DFlash draft, num_speculative_tokens=8) cannot boot on the production stack alongside 1M YaRN at the authorized gpu-memory-utilization 0.87: vLLM refuses startup with 'To serve at least one request with the model's max seq len (1048576), 49.41 GiB KV cache is needed, which is larger than the available KV cache memory (46.97 GiB)'. Shortfall 2.44 GiB. The draft resolves (DFlashDraftModel) and loads (target+draft 32.18 GiB vs 28.06 target-only); the collision is memory geometry with the 1M context, not method compatibility. Deterministic crash loop across repeated systemd attempts; production auto-restored and verified.

The discriminating null control ran and FAILED TO FIND A DIFFERENCE before any delta claim, as dispatched: baseline-vs-baseline across two independent boots through the identical harness measured 125.843 vs 125.871 tok/s (0.02% delta) with byte-identical output digests. Warm arms discarded 2 warmups each (stated in receipts); cold controls 0.16s both boots. The dflash arm never served, so no delta is claimed — the control establishes the harness could have detected one as small as ~2%.

The Marlin-fallback/native-path check was NOT REACHED: the engine dies at KV-cache sizing before kernel selection. The driver's own error_tail in 11_verdict.json mis-sliced the restore boot's lines; the true root-cause traceback is preserved separately and the timeline (16:15:38 first dflash attempt, crash 16:17:24, retry 16:17:42, restore boot 16:23:36) is reconstructed from the server log.

Paths that would let dflash8 fit — NOT executed per the stop-after-one-result bound, each requiring a ruling: (a) gpu-memory-utilization ~0.90+ (exceeds the founder-authorized 0.87 trim of 2026-07-24); (b) a dedicated dflash profile at reduced max-model-len (at 262,144 it fits with headroom); (c) FP8 KV for the draft. The 4B pilot's +36%-at-lower-acceptance signal remains untested on the 27B; the blocker is 2.44 GiB of memory geometry, not the method.
